name: kinema-by-objekts
description: Research personal film tastes from authorized viewing histories, ratings and watchlists.
long_description: Local MCP research engine for an AI assistant. Import authorized film observations, inspect coverage and conflicting ratings, plan source-based research, audit candidate films, save explicit feedback and erase the active local archive. The assistant independently verifies sources. A public profile pointer or recent RSS sample never establishes complete viewing history. No paid film or model API is required by the server; the chosen host has its own usage terms.

archive_file.title: Cinema archive file
archive_file.description: Optional absolute path to a JSON archive for one viewer. Leave empty to use ~/.local/share/objekts/cinema42.json. Selected archive evidence is returned to your AI host.
